verdict.rationale: Letta documents organization roles combined with sharing controls. Agents and conversations are private by default, and agents can be shared across a team with access permissions. Shared memory lives in Letta Cloud–hosted Git repositories that multiple agents can access. However, nothing shows memory-specific read/write policies or ACLs, and nothing shows an audit trail of who accessed memory. missing for 10: memory-level read/write ACLs or policies, governance of which agents or tools may write to shared memory, access audit logs, independent corroboration.
